description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about support work.

files.description: A Confluence page in the support-playbooks space for support agents, last updated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "When two documents disagree, the most recently dated statement is the current one."; "Policy pages are the source of truth; team notes, FAQs, quick references and Slack threads are summaries and can lag behind them."; "A change announcement or a correction replaces what came before it.". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
